column1: # Correction pass: blanket via -> through is too coarse.
# Google offers by / through / with / by using. Which one depends on what "via"
#   a channel, portal, product or enrollment path  -> through   (correct already)
#   a command, cmdlet, script or tool              -> using
#   a property or field you read a value out of    -> from
#   a URL you go to                                -> at
# Batch 1 (l1-runbooks) happened to be almost all channel-sense, which is why the
# blanket rule looked safe there. l2 is investigation runbooks, so it is full of
# cmdlets, Graph calls and device properties.
